title: AUTOMATED GENERATION OF MULTILINGUAL CLUSTERS FOR THE EVALUATION OF DISTRIBUTED REPRESENTATIONS
reasoning: The paper focuses on the automated creation of a dataset (WikiSem500) for the intrinsic evaluation of word embeddings using an outlier detection task. While it includes 'Summa Theologica' as a specific example of an outlier in one cluster, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, ethics, or morals as a component of the research.
